claims: Coachella 2026 takes place at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California.
The Empire Polo Club is located in the Coachella Valley of the Colorado Desert.
Coachella 2026 is scheduled for April 10–12, 2026, and April 17–19, 2026.
Headliners for Coachella 2026 are Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, and Karol G.
The location for Coachella 2026 is 81-800 Avenue 51, Indio, CA 92201.
Coachella 2026 is available to watch for free on YouTube and the Coachella app.
The Coachella 2026 venue has restricted pedestrian access on certain roads including Monroe Street.
